**The Impact You'll Make

**As our new Application Engineer, you will help customers turn technical requirements into practical solutions using frequency converters, drives and power conversion technologies.

You will combine technical expertise with commercial understanding, supporting customers from the first technical discussion and pre-sales phase through solution design, quotation, project execution, testing and commissioning.

An important part of your role will be to support marine and electrification applications, including battery energy storage systems, helping customers select, size and successfully implement the right solutions.

Based in Silkeborg, you will join a small, experienced application team where everyone manages their own customers and projects while sharing knowledge and supporting each other.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**

• Partner with our sales team and customers to understand technical requirements and design and size frequency converters, drives and power conversion solutions for customer applications.

• Act as trusted technical point of contact for key customers throughout the customer journey. This includes participating in customer meetings, project scoping and technical clarifications, and translating requirements into solutions and quotations.

• Manage the technical side of projects from pre-sales through implementation, verification testing and commissioning.

• Perform technical analyses such as harmonic distortion simulations, verification tests and evaluations against customer specifications, helping resolve technical challenges throughout the project.

• Share your expertise through technical presentations, product and software-tool training, and collaboration with sales colleagues, service partners and internal technical teams.

The role involves regular customer interaction and travel, primarily within Denmark and potentially Norway and Sweden. You can expect up to approximately 50 travel days per year.

**What We're Looking For

**We are open to different levels of experience. You may already have relevant industry experience, or you may be a recent graduate ready to build your career in a customer-facing technical role. Furthermore, you have:

• A relevant technical background e.g. in Marine Engineering, Electrical or Mechatronics engineering, or a technical trade or service background with extensive electrical understanding.

• A solid interest in motor control, frequency converters, drives and power conversion, with the technical curiosity to develop your understanding of products, systems and customer applications.

• Confidence working directly with customers and different stakeholders, combined with a proactive and structured approach to managing projects and priorities.

• Fluency in Danish and English, as you will work directly with Danish customers as well as colleagues and stakeholders across borders.

• Willingness to travel and work directly with customers and partners on-site when needed.

Experience with marine applications, electrification, drives, power conversion or related industries is an advantage but not essential. Familiarity with Danfoss Drives products or Salesforce is also beneficial.

Most importantly, you bring initiative, curiosity and a willingness to learn. If you are newly graduated, we are interested in your potential and motivation, not just the length of your CV.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll have the opportunity to develop a combination of technical, commercial and project management skills while taking real ownership of customers and projects.

Rather than focusing on only one stage, you can follow solutions from the initial customer requirement through design, implementation and commissioning.

You'll learn from experienced colleagues while building hands-on knowledge of frequency converters, drives, power conversion and electrification technologies, including applications within the marine industry.

The role offers a hybrid working model, with an expectation of being in our Silkeborg office two to three days per week.

You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you enjoy combining technology with customer interaction and want to take ownership of technical solutions from idea to implementation, we'd like to hear from you.

If you're at the beginning of your career, don't let that hold you back. We welcome applications from motivated recent graduates as well as experienced candidates. You don't need to meet every preferred qualification to make an impact in this role.

For more information about the position, please contact Senior Manager, Application Engineering, Daniel Aksel Sandgaard at +45 3010 3176 . For questions regarding the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner, Lisa Tveen Bachmann, at +45 2859 4039.

Apply and help us turn customer challenges into drive and electrification solutions that move our customers forward.

**Our Commitment to Transparency

The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Any benefits listed do not promise or guarantee any particular benefit or specific action. At Sumary, we are rebuilding finance from first principles. In short, we are creating the AI operating system for accounting work. Founded in 2025, Sumary is already used by some of the largest accounting firms in the world, including Deloitte, Grant Thornton and Baker Tilly, and the products we ship will define how finance teams work in the coming decade.

We have raised $29m, including the largest seed round ever in the Nordics, from Singular, byFounders, Partech and Tenity, and angels including Tuomas Artman (Linear), Morten Primdahl (Zendesk), Steve Anavi (Qonto), Stanislas Polu (Dust), Steffen Tjerrild (Synthesia), Jannick Malling (Public) and Ben Freeman (Omnea).

Our engineers are also our product managers and designers. You talk to customers, understand their pain points, design the best solution and ship it to a standard that sets the bar for the industry. You are confident owning features end to end, from the data model to the last pixel of the interface.

AI writes most of our code, so producing code is no longer the bottleneck. Judgment is: deciding what is worth building, and making it excellent. Just because something takes half a day to build doesn't mean it should exist.

We are a small team of full-stack generalists, TypeScript end to end, and product comes first in everything we build. What unites us is a deep care for craft, fast execution and the discipline to say no. We are looking for experienced engineers who thrive on autonomy and individual responsibility.

We have offices in Copenhagen and London. Copenhagen is our engineering hub, and this role is based there.

**Come help define and build the future of finance.

**What you'll do

• Work closely with founders and customers, and turn what you hear into the right solution, which is often not the one they asked for

• Build new user-facing features end to end, with beautiful and scalable UI components

• Obsessively improve performance, so every interaction feels instant, even for our largest accounting firms

• Use what you built the way a customer would, and polish it until it is right before it ships

• Delete by default: push back on scope, on features we shouldn't build and on anything that feels off

• When an agent gets something wrong, fix the tooling so it doesn't happen again for anyone

What we're looking for

• 5+ years building customer-facing products at a company known for the quality of its software

• Deep fluency in TypeScript and React, and confidence across the full stack: Node.js, Postgres and the data model underneath

• Product obsession and a good eye for design: you care about UX, speed and polish. You notice the slow interaction, the awkward empty state and the setting nobody needs, and you fix them without being asked

• A track record of shipping complete features end to end, not only incremental work

• Comfort working without a product manager. You would rather talk to the customer yourself

• High ownership: you take a problem from start to finish and care about how it lands

• You know the difference between extra effort and meaningful quality

• You build AI-first, directing agents through the implementation while you own the judgment

Nice to have

• Experience as one of the first engineers at a startup that went on to scale

• Interfaces you designed yourself, not only built

• Experience with financial and ledger data

Our stack

TypeScript end to end: React and Next.js, Node.js, Postgres and Supabase, Temporal, Modal and our AI service layers. We don't expect you to have used all of it.

Applying

Along with your CV, send us something you built that you are proud of, and one thing in a product you use every day that you would fix.

jobs.description:
**Your impact begins here

**As (Senior) Process Scientist, you will help move new tablet products from development into reliable, large-scale production. You will characterise, test, and validate tablet production processes so they work at manufacturing sites around the world, and prepare the documentation that supports market approval. Oral treatments are a strategic focus area at Novo and your work will help our patients and customers towards lasting health.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• An M.Sc. degree in Chemistry, Pharmacy, Engineering or another relevant academic area.

• Minimum 2 years of experience in oral product production, late-stage product development, drug product analysis, or clinical manufacturing

• General experience working within a GMP environment, knowledge of validation activities, and familiarity with regulatory documentation.

• Fluency in spoken and written English.

• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with team success ahead of personal achievement.

• A self-driven, quality-minded approach, with good planning and time-management skills to meet ambitious deadlines.

• Comfort working with some unknowns and many stakeholders, and the ability to adapt, learn and stay in control when situations are challenging.

**Useful, But Not Essential

**

• Experience from cross-organisational projects.

We welcome applications from both experienced and more junior candidates. The scope of the role can be adjusted to your level of experience, providing an opportunity to grow into the position. If you meet the core requirements, we encourage you to apply.

**What You’ll Do

**You will work on late-phase manufacturing science for new tablet products, preparing processes for large-scale market production.

**You Will Have The Opportunity To

**

• Drive scientific progress to reach project milestones, delivering on characterisation studies, test runs, and process validation activities.

• Work with production sites to solve technical challenges with blenders, granulators, tablet machines, in-process control systems, and process analytical technologies (PAT).

• Update and maintain critical process documentation, quality statements, scientific rationales and health authority submission files.

• Apply and uphold the relevant standards. Where a standard does not fully fit the situation, use your own scientific judgement to find the best way forward.

• Learn from how new ways of working meet reality at the sites, adapt your approach, and help update the standard so others can benefit.

The role is based in Taastrup, with some workdays in Måløv, and includes up to 25 international travel days a year, depending on your project.

**Who You’ll Work With

**You will join New Product Introduction (NPI) within Tablet Manufacturing Science and Technology (TMSAT) in Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS). Tablet MSAT supports the global network of tablet manufacturing sites by introducing new products, managing the processes and quality of marketed products, and developing new technology to improve performance.

NPI is a rapidly growing department of around 20 colleagues, working with an expanding pipeline of tablet products. Together, we develop, scale up and validate blending, granulation and compression processes, and make sure the product’s stability, specifications and quality hold up. We work in cross-functional project groups, united by shared team goals, and we share experience and knowledge as we go.

You will collaborate closely with development departments, production sites, quality assurance, quality control, regulatory affairs and the scientists who support marketed products. The stakeholders you work with will change as projects move forward, so you will keep building your network.

**What You Can Expect Here

**Oral treatments are a strategic focus area for Novo, and the landscape is dynamic. That means varied projects, new ways to broaden your skills and a chance to see your work make a difference at sites around the world. You will have a highly engaged, supportive team around you, and room to develop your professional and personal competences as the department grows.

**Salary

**For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 638,200.00 to 938,100.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to take new tablet products from development to patients around the world, apply for the (Senior) Process Scientist role by 26 November 2026.

We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For further information, please contact Chris Arnrød Andersen, Director at ciaq@novonordisk.com or +45-30752190.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

jobs.occupation: Tech Lead, Video Conferencing & Screen Sharing
jobs.description:
Most companies that do conferencing hand you one slice of it. The desktop app, or the media pipeline, or, maybe, the join flow. Everything else you pass over a wall to another team. Not in this case. One team owns the whole path across the Airtame platform: Airtame 3, Airtame Go, Virtual Airtame, and browser, desktop, and mobile apps that go with them. The bar remains at an effortless experience. Someone walks into a room, and starts sharing. No app to hunt for, no login to chase.

The team is four engineers, and we're hiring their technical and people lead: someone who spends about 60% of time hands-on with the hardest problems, and the rest growing the engineers around them.

**About Airtame

**We're around 55 people, headquartered in Copenhagen, and you'd work from there or remotely from within the EU. We make the hardware and the software that runs on it, so a call you make about the streaming stack ends up in a product bolted to a wall in meeting rooms around the world. The team is small, works across disciplines, and reaches a global market from a small base.

Year one outcomes

Make joining a call one step that works. Today, getting an authenticated meeting started from a room takes too many turns: personal logins, manual entry, a different quirk on every platform. A year from now, starting a scheduled call on Teams, Zoom, Google Meet, or Webex should be something a room just does. Judge it by how often it works on the first try, and how rarely it reaches support.

Take the friction out of screen sharing. The browser path loses first-time users: too many clicks, not enough signposting. You'll own getting a newcomer from a short code to their screen on the wall without a stumble, and getting Miracast and AirPlay stable enough to turn on by default.

Make it behave the same everywhere. The experience varies between Airtame 3, Virtual Airtame, browser, desktop, and mobile today. By year-end, sharing and calling should feel like one product no matter which surface you're on, with real-time quality that holds up on whatever network the room happens to have.

Lead the team. You'll run the 1:1s, set the technical bar, and support team members' growth. The measure is simple: a year in, the team runs on your leadership day to day.

Push AI-assisted development further. The team already builds with AI daily. You'll lead the next step: sharper workflows, better tooling choices, new patterns that make the whole group faster. By year-end, the team's AI practices should be visibly ahead of where they started.

Who you are

• The player-coach. You've owned a team's technical direction: the architecture calls, the reviews where the hard problems get caught. And you want the people side too. Growing engineers, running 1:1s, hiring. You're not looking to trade one for the other. Maybe you've been a staff engineer or tech lead ready to own a team, or a manager who never stopped building. Either way, 60/40 sounds about right to you.

• Comfortable across the stack. Real-time media is second nature to you: WebRTC, streaming, the way audio and video behave over a network you don't control. You've gone deep somewhere, whether a media pipeline, native protocols, or a cross-platform client, and you can hold your own everywhere else, on browser, desktop, and mobile.

• You've made stubborn systems cooperate. Half this job is getting software to play nicely with platforms you don't own: Teams, Zoom, Meet, Webex, the operating system's own media APIs, each with its own idea of how things should go. You've done that kind of integration, and you keep your head when every platform behaves differently.

• You measure yourself by the room. Your bar is the person standing at the "share" button. Someone who's never seen an Airtame, getting their screen up first try with no help. That's what you optimize for, and it steers the calls you make when something has to give.

• You use AI as a daily tool. You write code with it, debug with it, prototype with it. You've formed your own view on where it speeds things up and where it gets in the way, and you help the people around you do the same.

**Logistics

**Location: Remote in Europe, or hybrid from our Copenhagen office.

Employment type: Full-time preferred. We're also open to a project-based contract scoped to delivering the native protocol implementations.

****Why Airtame:

• The defining calls are still ahead. Airtame's collaboration software keeps spreading across more devices and form factors, so the shape of the next phase is still open, and you'd be the one setting it.

• At our size, a major call you make shows up in front of customers within weeks, so the feedback comes back fast.

• A healthy work-life balance.

• Significant responsibility and ownership over projects and your field of expertise.

• Five weeks paid vacation and 5 days of extra paid AirtameFlex days.

• Flexible work environment, with a hybrid mindset.

• Pension and private health insurance (on FTE Copenhagen contract).

Airtame is an equal opportunity employer. We have colleagues across the globe, with both in-office and full-time remote workers. This feeds into our international hybrid mindset, with people from 25+ nationalities that make up the Airtame team.

Our work-life cultural balance is key to our success. Our team encompasses our values of trust and open communication to support each other and to collaborate in a fun and collective way.

****What Our Employment Decisions Are NOT Based On

****Race, colour, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, family or parental status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status. And we will not tolerate discrimination or harassment.

****What Our Employment Decisions ARE Based On

****Business needs, job requirements, individual qualifications, and candidates potential for growing with Airtame.

****How We Handle Your Application Data

****Airtame ApS (CVR 35478973, Copenhagen), together with Airtame US Inc. for US roles, processes the information you submit to assess your application. We do this under the EU General Data Protection Regulation, wherever you are based. Your data is stored in Greenhouse, our recruiting system, which may store it outside the EU under standard EU safeguards. Only the people involved in hiring can see it. For roles with privileged access to our systems, we’ll contact one professional reference or previous employer that you name, to confirm your role and dates. We’ll tell you before we do. We keep your data for 6 months after the recruitment process ends, or longer where US law requires it or where you consent to us keeping it for future roles. To get a copy of your data, correct or delete it, or object to how we use it, write to data@airtame.com. You can also complain to the Danish Data Protection Agency (Datatilsynet).

****What Our Employment Decisions ARE Based On

****Business needs, job requirements, individual qualifications, and candidates potential for growing with Airtame.

**What's in it for you?

**

• Work close to the hardware. You design with the firmware team, whose building blocks you combine like Lego into new device configurations.

• Learn from experienced colleagues. You join a team with people who have 20+ years of experience and who are first movers on technology and AI.

**Who are you ideally?

• Solid hands-on experience with Java, Spring Boot and GraphQL, including designing APIs and databases and the services around them.

• You are results-driven and self-driven: you unblock yourself, reach out to the right people early and follow your work through to delivery.

• You like to learn from the team and bring others along, and you can design a solution end to end, from database to service, and explain your choices to colleagues in firmware and across engineering.

• Domain knowledge can be learned. An IoT background, such as an understanding of protocols, is a plus, but we value learning speed more.

AI is the core of how our team builds software, including a shared AI development workflow. We expect you to use AI as your main development platform, or to be keen to. Hands-on experience with AI-first development is a big plus.

**Primary Responsibilities

**

• Build new device configurations for our device administration tool, designed together with the firmware team, including bulk configuration updates for customers.

• Develop the backend behind them: API extensions, GraphQL, database design and orchestration, Java services and Kafka topics.

• Take features from the first idea to a device in the field, in close collaboration with our firmware and hardware teams.

• Support the rest of the device lifecycle, including installation, verification and the internal tool our hardware and firmware teams use to debug devices.

• Help the team grow: share what you know, review each other's work and raise the bar together.

****Our hiring process

****Don't waste your time on writing the best possible cover letter for the job. We want you to create an impact that matters, and that's not in the cover letter.

• Virtual meet and greet. Meet with the Talent Acquisition Partner.

• A deeper conversation: We'll go into your experience and how you work, and you'll get a clearer picture of the team, the challenges, and what the role actually looks like day to day.

• Assignment-specific interview. We want you to get an insight into some of the concrete work tasks or projects related to the role. You will be given a case to prepare prior to the interview, and at the interview, you will present the case to relevant colleagues from across Trackunit, who you’ll also work closely with in the job.

• If needed, throughout the process we will obtain references from former employers and do background checks for level specific, if you have not provided these yourself.

• Offer presentation and walk-through. We’re lucky to have you!

****Coming Together To Connect Construction

****We’re committed to construction - one of the largest industries in the world. Over the past two decades, Trackunit has been pioneering technological progress within construction. Today, we are not only a leading IoT provider but a thought leader, supporting and shaping the agenda for an entire industry on a global scale.

We believe in taking a people approach in everything we do. Being human-centric is not restricted to our products – it’s a way of life at Trackunit. We’re proud to be a truly global team. Our colleagues get together in hubs spread across the globe, but we embrace the idea of working remotely and in environments that inspire you. Everything we do, we do it to eliminate downtime and build the most useful industry for the world.

The question is: Are you in?

At Sumary, we are rebuilding finance from first principles. In short, we are creating the AI operating system for accounting work. Founded in 2025, Sumary is already used by some of the largest accounting firms in the world, including Deloitte, Grant Thornton and Baker Tilly, and the products we ship will define how finance teams work in the coming decade.

We have raised $29m, including the largest seed round ever in the Nordics, from Singular, byFounders, Partech and Tenity, and angels including Tuomas Artman (Linear), Morten Primdahl (Zendesk), Steve Anavi (Qonto), Stanislas Polu (Dust), Steffen Tjerrild (Synthesia), Jannick Malling (Public) and Ben Freeman (Omnea).

Our engineers are also our product managers and designers. You talk to customers, understand their pain points, design the best solution and ship it to a standard that sets the bar for the industry. You are confident owning features end to end, from the data model to the last pixel of the interface.

AI writes most of our code, so producing code is no longer the bottleneck. Judgment is: deciding what is worth building, and making it excellent. Just because something takes half a day to build doesn't mean it should exist.

We are a small team of full-stack generalists, TypeScript end to end, and product comes first in everything we build. What unites us is a deep care for craft, fast execution and the discipline to say no. We are looking for experienced engineers who thrive on autonomy and individual responsibility.

We have offices in Copenhagen and London. Copenhagen is our engineering hub, and this role is based there.

**Come help define and build the future of finance.

**What you'll do

• Work closely with founders and customers, and turn what you hear into the right solution, which is often not the one they asked for

• Build new user-facing features end to end, with beautiful and scalable UI components

• Obsessively improve performance, so every interaction feels instant, even for our largest accounting firms

• Use what you built the way a customer would, and polish it until it is right before it ships

• Delete by default: push back on scope, on features we shouldn't build and on anything that feels off

• When an agent gets something wrong, fix the tooling so it doesn't happen again for anyone

What we're looking for

• 5+ years building customer-facing products at a company known for the quality of its software

• Deep fluency in TypeScript and React, and confidence across the full stack: Node.js, Postgres and the data model underneath

• Product obsession and a good eye for design: you care about UX, speed and polish. You notice the slow interaction, the awkward empty state and the setting nobody needs, and you fix them without being asked

• A track record of shipping complete features end to end, not only incremental work

• Comfort working without a product manager. You would rather talk to the customer yourself

• High ownership: you take a problem from start to finish and care about how it lands

• You know the difference between extra effort and meaningful quality

• You build AI-first, directing agents through the implementation while you own the judgment

Nice to have

• Experience as one of the first engineers at a startup that went on to scale

• Interfaces you designed yourself, not only built

• Experience with financial and ledger data

Our stack

TypeScript end to end: React and Next.js, Node.js, Postgres and Supabase, Temporal, Modal and our AI service layers. We don't expect you to have used all of it.

Applying

Along with your CV, send us something you built that you are proud of, and one thing in a product you use every day that you would fix.

Veo is an AI-powered sports camera and analysis ecosystem built for one job: turning what happens on a pitch into proof. Capture, viewing, data and analytics, sharing- all in one system, all pointed at the same thing.

That's bigger than football. Every player, on every pitch, gets access to the kind of proof only the top academies used to keep for themselves. It's the future we're building.

Every youth match still has a moment nobody saw. A run that won the game, underneath everyone's radar. A kid written off before anyone actually checked. We exist to close that gap, one match at a time.

One camera on any pitch feeds an AI that tracks every player and the ball for the whole game, turning what happened into evidence instead of somebody's opinion.

That's the actual job here. Not shipping features. Building the system that gives proof to someone who used to rely on a hunch.

If you've ever watched a match and wondered who else saw what you saw, you already know why this matters.

We're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

We are looking for a Data Regulation Counsel to support Veo’s work within data protection and emerging technology regulation. You will play a key role in the day-to-day operation of Veo’s compliance framework and help ensure that our products, services, development, and internal processes meet applicable regulatory requirements.

You will join the Legal Team, currently consisting of four full-time employees, and work closely with it, as well as colleagues across IT, Marketing, Product, and other business areas. While the role's primary focus is GDPR compliance, your tasks will also include operational compliance related to NIS2, the Data Act, the Cyber Resilience Act, and the AI Act.

This is a unique opportunity to join a growing Legal function and help build scalable, pragmatic compliance processes at a company experiencing significant growth and continuous development.

**You can expect tasks within a variety of areas, including:

**

• Supporting the implementation and day-to-day operation of Veo’s data regulation compliance framework, ensuring that established processes are followed and continuously improved.

• Assisting in ensuring that Veo’s products, services, and internal data processing activities comply with applicable data regulation requirements.

• Providing practical and solution-oriented support to teams across Veo on data regulation matters, with a focus on translating legal requirements into operational processes.

• Drafting, updating, and maintaining relevant policies, procedures, and documentation, including privacy notices, records of processing activities, transfer impact assessments, incident response procedures, and documentation required under the regulatory frameworks.

• Supporting the handling of operational compliance tasks, including data subject rights requests, personal data breaches, and security incidents.

• Contributing to drafting and facilitating training and awareness initiatives.

• Supporting the management of third-party relationships from a compliance perspective, including assisting with due diligence, contractual requirements, and ongoing monitoring.

• Contributing to the ongoing monitoring, development, optimization, and, where relevant, automation of compliance processes, ensuring that Veo’s approach remains scalable and aligned with business needs.

Previous experience with all of the above is not required.

**Your qualifications:

**

• A master’s degree in law or business law from a Nordic university.

• Solid experience with advising on GDPR and/or other data regulation. Experience from scale ups or law firms is an advantage but not required..

• An interest in and basic understanding of broader technology regulation (e.g. NIS2, AI Act, Data Act).

• A pragmatic and structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to translate legal requirements into commercial and operational solutions.

• An interest in working closely with stakeholders across different functions and with varying professional backgrounds.

• A solid understanding of and interest in technology and artificial intelligence.

• The ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a dynamic environment.

• Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.

At Veo, the Legal Team is part of the Finance Department, and you will report to the Head of Legal. In your day-to-day work, you will collaborate closely with our experienced Data Protection Counsel. We offer an informal working environment where individual contributions are highly valued, both professionally and socially. We encourage personal and professional development while providing a flexible work environment, even during busy periods.

Our Copenhagen office mirrors our innovative technology – with an indoor ball court, rooftop terrace, and well-equipped gym. We have created a facility that supports connecting disciplines across the business, facilitates creative thinking, and gives the space to engage with colleagues, our global partners, and the entire Veo community.

Values we hold at Veo:

Dare - We take initiative, stay curious, and challenge the status quo in our work.

Own it - We drive impact by identifying opportunities, taking responsibility, and confidently executing.

Level up - We embrace growth, continuously learning and shaping our skills.

Play as a team - We collaborate across a diverse organization, leveraging shared insights for stronger

outcomes.

Customer Centric - We deliver value by having close partnerships and a deep understanding of our customers (internally and externally)

We value diversity and inclusion and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, even if your experience doesn’t completely match every qualification listed. What matters most is your creativity, potential, and ability to make meaningful contributions.

💰 Salary, based on experience level: 🇬🇧 London - up to £92 000 a year/gross 🇩🇰 Copenhagen - up to 74 000 DKK a month/gross

Intro

Monta powers the EV charging ecosystem. With 300,000+ monthly users and millions of charge sessions every month, our platform accelerates the electrification of mobility.

This is a fast-moving place. The problems are hard, the pace is quick, and the bar is high. If you like real ownership, figuring things out, and seeing the direct impact of your work, you'll do well with us.

AI is built into how we work. It helps us ship faster, make better decisions, and stay lean. Everyone at Monta is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully — and to find smart ways to use them to move the work forward.

Our principles keep us grounded: Build Together & Finish, Sweat the Details, Customer First, and Aim for the Moon.

The best part of Monta is the people — sharp, ambitious, and good to be around. You'll be challenged, supported, and trusted to deliver.

We're looking for a Solution Engineer who's ready to roll up their sleeves, take ownership, and build with us — through the grind and the wins. You'll be the technical partner to our Sales team: you work out what customers need, show them how Monta solves it, and make sure what we sell can be delivered.

This Is What You Will Achieve

• Win the technical decision — be the reason charge point operators, energy companies and fleet owners choose Monta to run their charging business.

• Make sure what we sell gets delivered — the commitments made during the sale are realistic and land cleanly with our implementation team.

• Shape the product — turn what you hear from customers into clear input that Product and Engineering can act on.

What You Will Do

• Lead technical discovery — understand the customer's business, their current charging setup (platform, hardware, roaming, billing) and what they need to integrate with.

• Run demos built around the customer — tailored to their use cases, not a feature tour.

• Design the solution — define the high-level architecture and integration approach, from OCPP chargers and OCPI roaming to APIs, ERP and energy management.

• Lead proofs of concept and technical evaluations — agree scope and success criteria up front and see them through to sign-off.

• Answer the hard questions — technical, architecture, integration and security questions in meetings, RFPs and security questionnaires.

• Spot risk early — flag gaps and dependencies before a deal is committed, and push back when a promise can't be kept.

• Partner with Sales — on the technical strategy for complex, multi-country deals.

• Hand over cleanly — give the Solution Architect a documented scope so implementation starts on solid ground.

• Close the loop with Product — feed recurring requirements and product gaps back to Product and Engineering.

• Help post-sales when it's busy — for example scoping a migration or running a technical workshop with a live customer.

What We're Looking For

• Experience in a customer-facing technical role — as a Solution Engineer, Sales Engineer or pre-sales consultant, selling B2B software or platform products.

• You explain technical topics clearly to non-technical people — and can go deep with the customer's engineers in the same meeting.

• Your discovery gets to the real problem — you ask the question behind the requirement before proposing a solution.

• You build demos that tell the customer's story — you're comfortable changing course live when the conversation goes somewhere new.

• Hands-on with APIs and integrations — you can read API docs, test calls yourself, and explain web-hooks, authentication and data flows.

• Commercial awareness — you understand how deals are won and lost, and you know when to protect scope.

• You write clearly — solution designs, RFP answers and handover notes that others can act on without a follow-up call.

• EV charging, energy or mobility knowledge is a plus (OCPP, OCPI, load management), but not required. We'll teach you the domain.

• You use AI to work faster — for example on RFP drafts, research, demo prep and documentation, and you check the output before it reaches a customer.

• Fluent English, and happy to travel to customer workshops around Europe from time to time.

**_If the mission excites you but your experience isn't a perfect 1:1 match, apply anyway — we care about potential, not perfection.

_**Why Monta

• Impact, not easy mode — your work matters, and you'll feel it every day.

• Ownership from day one — we don't micromanage, we expect you to deliver.

• The grind is real — priorities shift, and flexibility is sometimes needed to get things across the finish line. But so are the rewards: impact, growth, and a team that has your back.

• The people are extraordinary — talented, driven, and fun to work with. You'll be challenged, supported, and inspired in equal measure.

What We Offer

• A yearly education budget and extra days off to use it.

• A friendly and social company culture with movie nights, Friday bars, pub crawls, and more.

• Free lunch every day.

• Pension & health coverage to keep you secure for today and tomorrow.

• Paid parental leave to support life's big moments.

• Warrants program - be part of our growth story.

• Flexible working hours; as long as you're at key meetings and delivering great work, we trust you to manage your schedule.

**Please send us your application in English.

**To succeed in this position, your spoken and written English skills need to be proficient. Since Monta is a globally active company, you'll be communicating often and regularly with our co-workers and partners around the world, making your professional English knowledge essential.

Please note that we don't accept unsolicited applications from headhunters or recruitment agencies. Unsolicited applications sent to our company or co-workers are considered to be the property of Monta, and we won't agree to pay any referral compensation or recruiter fee without a signed agreement.

Find out more by visiting https://monta.com/uk/careers/

• Framing the real problem behind the ask, and shaping it into an engagement worth running together with our FDEs

• Sequencing what gets built, in what order, and being accountable for the business value - not just the artifact

• Steering engineering teams toward outcomes, translating in both directions between the client and the builders

**You'll Join a Team Where

**

• people care deeply about what they build

• good ideas move quickly

• new technology gets explored early

• and where there is room to shape both the company and the way we work

**

• Pension plan

• Parental leave

• Social gatherings

• New tech gear

• Central office

• Free lunch, coffee, snacks, and Friday beers

• Skill development

• Paid holiday

• Pet friendly

Would you like to lead and further develop the Finance function at Denmark’s largest refinery? Kalundborg Refinery is seeking an experienced Head of Finance to combine hands-on operational finance leadership with strategic influence on site performance.

• Ensuring operational excellence within Finance and compliance with applicable requirements and Company policies.

• Analysing existing routes, potential routes and aviation market data, supporting work in growing passenger throughput, generating business cases and providing valuable data to the Route Development, Marketing & Communications team

• Helping attract and win new airline services, tour operators and air freight providers among other business development opportunities by way of sharp and investigative analysis

• Work astutely with market intelligence and data – from reporting, analysing, market-sizing and trend development, to identifying, researching and underpinning new business opportunity by smartly applying business acumen

• Develop a grasp and detailed understanding of population dynamics, socio-economic, migration and immigration as well as regional economic trends across Denmark and applicable international communities, as well as trade and tourism

• Using both new and available data and analytical methodology, support the commercial activity, sales, marketing and communication initiatives of the organisation

• Produce, research and maintain analytical and insight tools to help optimally showcase Aarhus Airport’s market, regional economy and destination assets

• Support the knowledge-building of AAR’s work in economic, aviation and wider industry trends

• Support work with stakeholders and business partners from around the industry and region including tourism partners, corporate customers, airlines and tour operator partners

• Assist with applicable project management and business development by way of competent planning, modelling, budgeting and forecasting

• Assist in commercial calculations, analysis and negotiations with management and leadership, in pursuit of incremental revenue sustainability and asset optimisation

• Co-operate closely with marketing, communications, administration, customer service and operational colleagues

• Attend and support airline and tour operator negotiations as required, including attendance of industry conferences, conventions and exhibitions. The role involves some international travel which should appeal to your general wanderlust and passion for travel, tourism and/or aviation

The right candidate will, among other attributes, demonstrate that they have:

• Strong skill sets in analytical, business and/or commercial arena and ideally some international work experience, or a very significant interest in this field. Perhaps you have worked in travel already or are keen to do so, maybe an interest in airport, airline and the travel sector in general

• A business degree of relevance with a lean towards statistical, data and analytical strengths, possibly within business, economics, marketing, communications or another commercial discipline

• Fluency in English, perhaps a Scandinavian language too. Additional languages are an advantage

• A head for numbers, strong IT and excellent interpersonal communication skills are a must. Fully competent in excel, powerpoint, other IT suites and data tools, where thinking outside of the box, challenging assumptions with evidence and insight, above all being inquisitive and solution-oriented are second nature

• The ability to work confidently and in a structured way with extensive data material and in detail, producing meaningful analysis, reports, proposals and delivering valuable insight to colleagues and decision-makers. At the same time you are able to work independently and as part of a team, tie dynamic data and insight together and present complex data in an attractive way, visually and verbally

• The ability to gain security clearance from the Danish Police, hold a valid passport and have or obtain the right to live and work in Aarhus, Denmark is a minimum requirement.

Aarhus Airport offers a range of benefits in line with qualifications and experience. We have towering ambitions for the future and invite you to join us if the above snapshot is a fit and you are keen to contribute in building the region’s future international connectivity, and the potential to develop your career with us excites you. We are an equal opportunities employer and an organisation that likes to stand out from the crowd, we thrive on excellence and diversity within our team regardless of background, ethnicity, gender or sexual orientation. We expect the review of applications and interviews to be ongoing until the position is filled, and encourage you to reach out as soon as possible if the opportunity resonates.

We look forward to receiving your CV and covering letter with an indication of salary expectations via the application link on our website. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us by email at dsu@aar.dk

Would you like to drive the commercial growth of a world-leading protein analysis contract research organization (CRO)? Alphalyse seeks a commercially driven Marketing Director to strengthen our market position and win new biopharmaceutical clients worldwide.

About the role

As Marketing Director, you will own Alphalyse’s marketing strategy and brand and be the central point for everything we communicate to the market. You will lead and develop our marketing function and work closely with management, sales, and our scientific experts. You will take ownership, set priorities, make decisions, and turn ideas into coordinated, high-quality material that reaches our clients.

Our market consists of a limited number of biopharmaceutical companies, and many of them do not yet know what modern protein analysis can do for them. Educating the market is therefore a key part of the job, and so is making sure that our strong scientific profile is matched by a clear commercial message.

The position is based at our headquarters in Odense, Denmark, and you will lead our communications specialist and work closely with our sales and business development teams in both Denmark and the United States.

Your responsibilities

• Develop and execute the marketing strategy and plan, aligned with our commercial goals

• Be the guardian of the Alphalyse brand, and own the communication plan, PR, and our external newsletter

• Identify target accounts and decision-makers, and run account-based campaigns that generate qualified leads

• Educate the market through webinars, case studies, and thought leadership.

• Define the right marketing KPIs, track performance, and adjust quickly based on what generates pipeline

• Be the landing place for good ideas from across the organization for client material, posts, and content. Decide what to pursue and turn it into finished output

• Coordinate all marketing material, so our messaging is consistent across channels, client meetings, sales, and events

• Plan and run conferences and events, and make sure we show up with strong material

• Lead and develop our communications specialist, and act as a business development partner to sales and management

Who you are

You are a commercially minded marketing leader with high personal drive and a hands-on approach. You thrive on handling many different activities at once and keep momentum without losing sight of priorities. You are a strong communicator, an engaged people leader, and a natural sparring partner for management and sales. You quickly grasp complex technical offerings and explain their value clearly to scientists and decision-makers alike. You are an early adopter of AI and always look for smarter ways of working.

Professional qualifications

Required

• Deep B2B marketing and branding experience at a strategic level, including developing and implementing marketing strategies

• Proven track record of marketing a niche, technical B2B product or service to a small, well-defined customer base

• Strong commercial instincts and comfort being measured on pipeline and revenue

• A proven ability to turn strategy into execution across PR, content, events, campaigns, and product launches

• Experience leading and developing employees, including setting priorities and making decisions for a team

• Excellent written and spoken English

Preferred

• Experience with account-based marketing and CRM tools

• Experience educating a market about new technologies or services

• Experience with websites, digital marketing, and video content

• Knowledge of the biopharmaceutical industry, life science, or analytical techniques

What we offer

• A senior role with real influence on Alphalyse’s commercial strategy and growth

• The chance to shape our marketing as the company grows

• Close collaboration with management, a world-class scientific team and our sales organization

• A market where regulatory change is creating new demand for our services

Are you interested?

To apply, please send your CV to job@alphalyse.com no later than 10 December 2026. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. If you have questions about the role, please contact CEO Thomas Kofoed at +45 2045 2038.

About Alphalyse

Alphalyse is a Danish contract research laboratory founded in 2002. We use our passion for protein analysis to help clients develop safe and effective biopharmaceuticals. An innovative approach has made us world leaders in quantifying Host Cell Proteins using a unique mass spectrometry method.

Our technical experts make the analysis results accessible to understand and use, and they take pride in building strong and rewarding relationships with our clients. Our most important asset is our team of highly skilled employees, and we encourage a work environment that is exciting, challenging, and fun.

Learn more at www.alphalyse.com

• Connect Customer Implementation and Integration to create more seamless customer journeys
